svg.title: Northern Illinois Brick Club: Many interests. One club.
svg.desc: A printable club introduction. Public shows welcome visitors of all ages. Adults 18 and older can ask about joining. Visit niltc.org or email niltc.contact@gmail.com.

g.text: We build trains, castles, creatures, and more with LEGO bricks.
See our creations at public shows across northern Illinois.
Tell us what you like to build.
Formerly Northern Illinois LEGO Train Club
LEGO is a trademark of the LEGO Group, which does not sponsor or endorse this club.
